# How long the harness module's slow tests take on a GitHub runner (4 vCPU,
# go test -race, the default MIMICRY_PROFILES), in seconds. Read by
# .github/scripts/harness-shard.sh to split the tests into CI shards; a test
# not listed counts as 2 seconds. Estimated from runs on an M-series Mac:
# tests that compute (the generators, decoding the page captures) take about
# twice as long on the runner, tests that wait out timers (HTTP/3, the
# connection traces) about as long.
#
# A slow test needs a line here, or the shard it lands in can run past the
# 15-minute limit: `bash .github/scripts/harness-shard.sh plan 5` prints the
# split. `Test/regex` runs a slice of a test's subtests as its own unit (a
# test whose subtests alone take longer than a shard should); the subtests no
# slice matches run as one more unit. `TestA|TestB` keeps tests in one unit.
#
# seconds  package          test[/subtests]
355        ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^chrome-
165        ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^firefox-
160        ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles/^safari-
155        ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
100        ./cmd/h3gen      TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles
25         ./cmd/h3gen      TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
30         ./cmd/kindsgen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles
9          ./cmd/kindsgen   TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures
240        ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser
# Both replay every page capture, decoded once per test binary (pagesOnce,
# nearly all of their time): apart, each would decode them.
240        ./e2e            TestChainedPrioritiesMatchBrowserTraces|TestHPACKReproducesBrowserBlocks
115        ./e2e            TestConnectionMatchesBrowserTrace
110        ./e2e            TestInheritedProfile
60         ./e2e            TestHTTP3MatchesBrowser
40         ./e2e            TestWebSocketsMatchBrowser
35         ./e2e            TestHTTP3DownloadMatchesBrowser
30         ./e2e            TestHTTP3ACKEvery
20         ./e2e            TestQUICInterop
10         ./e2e            TestCORSMatchesBrowser
10         ./e2e            TestDeflateReproducesBrowserMessages
10         ./e2e            TestResumptionMatchesBrowser
8          ./e2e            TestConnectionsMatchBrowser
